verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair axis for an observability platform that stores logs, metrics and traces, but the evidence pack never documents retention periods, deletion APIs or purge controls. Mentions of long-term storage (Mimir), object-store chunk storage (Loki) and Adaptive Telemetry aggregation describe where data is stored or how costs are cut. None of them gives a user control over how long data is kept or how it is deleted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
